geometry_edits.rationale: Replace the generic bend-driven section with a profiled hall language to strengthen section continuity and public-threshold legibility without abandoning the dominant datum.
Use a folded section family to create a clearer inhabited roof/section response for neighborhood living.
Align the section to the long axis so the primary mass reads as one coherent street-building datum.
Convert the overhang logic into a true courtyard/public void structure that better supports the program contract.
Carve a proportioned public court so the ground edge becomes active and usable.
Open the court toward the verified access side to align the public threshold with the road frontage.

graph_edits.rationale: Shift the dominant mass from a generic bar to a more site-responsive split-wing/readable threshold form that can express a public edge.
Orient the split so the west-side program frame can better generate an entry/public seam toward the access side.
Open a more legible void within the dominant mass to produce usable public space rather than a sealed extrusion.
Keep the dominant mass continuous enough to preserve hierarchy while allowing a clear ground-level void.
Align the carved ground response to the verified access edge so the public threshold is semantically clear.
Widen the carve to make the access opening visibly public rather than incidental.

rationale: The candidate is a coherent four-view mass and the parcel containment appears respected, but the visible form is still dominated by a compact stacked bar rather than a convincingly neighborhood-active ground condition. The bent/cantilevered language is present, yet the road frontage reads as mostly sealed or at best only weakly acknowledged; the thick blue access edge does not receive a clearly legible public seam, court, notch, or undercut. Across views the object is readable, but the section remains shallow and the void strategy feels incidental rather than program-defining. For a neighborhood_living brief, this can plausibly host the program only if the street edge and public threshold are strengthened and the mass is opened into a more deliberate court/entry condition. As shown, program_fit_hard_pass fails because the dominant gesture does not yet support the required active ground edge and public-space logic.
